image_description: A close-up shot of a bathroom toilet paper holder containing two rolls. The top roll is nearly empty, showing the cardboard core and some printed text/graphics on the remaining paper. The bottom roll is fuller but also features prominent, nonsensical text and graphic artifacts printed on the surface of the tissue. The lighting is warm and dim, casting shadows on the wall behind the metallic holder.
